coverage.origin_classification: Frontend: source driver functions outside runtime.c. CRT: runtime.c overrides plus matched LIBC.LIB/SETARGV code. Imports: import thunks. Includes shared text data; categories are disjoint. This describes the reconstruction origins, not a complete original linker map.
coverage.metric: Union of accepted original code extents, shared text data, CRT and import thunks, clipped to code-section VirtualSize; not branch coverage.

warning_contract: Six exact intentional original child warnings, including old-style prototype differences and both accepted function/data-pointer conversion expressions. Original program silently exits0; incompatible narrow prototype is never invoked.
interpretations: Original2b530 takes DeclarationSpec* and FrontendSymbol* and returns the bound parameter. The unvisited provisional set_declaration_name char* annotation was corrected to declare_old_style_parameter, preserving both stack slots/RET8. Raw earlier frontier annotation retained, not relabeled as a historically correct prototype.

Register-parameter cleanup writes full DWORD1 to its eight-byte work entry. Added named saved_depth union view while preserving preexisting byte-depth and symbol-pointer views; explicit layout/offset assertions compile under both toolchains.

New has_parameter_shape_depth3f7f0 callee remains a named trap; its branch was not reached. Function-designator helper402b0 and conversion-diagnostic3c380 also remain unaccepted; proposal estimates are not reachability claims.

remaining_inventory.caveat: Remaining outside identified CRT/imports includes application functions, unresolved support, shared data and padding; no claim all bytes are reachable application instructions. Accepted source count and extent do not establish branch completion.
